articleTitle: Performance Analysis of an Urban Passenger Vehicle Powertrain Operating in Various Driving Cycle and Speed Profiles Using MatLab Simscape Models
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: The paper refers to the powertrain systems in urban electric passenger vehicles (EPV). The purpose of the work is to analyse the performance of the powertrain systems of an EPV with different parameters operating in various driving cycles and speed profiles. This paper introduces some modifications to the Simscape model of the EPV powertrain system model developed in previous studies. The analysis method uses the simulation modelling of the EPV powertrain and performance analyses during a standard driving cycle and speed profiles with a graphical and numerical representation of the results. Simulations show that the operating areas in which EPV powertrains work during urban and highway driving cycle profiles differ, and the efficiency of the EPV system overall is influenced, which can be improved by introducing a two-speed transmission in the EPV powertrain architecture.

articleTitle: Useful Experiment Based Formulas for Estimating the Heating of Crimped Connections
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: In this work, some useful formulas based on experimental determinations are presented that can be used to estimate the heating of crimped connections, saving the experimenter from additional, long and expensive tests. The study is carried out within a heating cycle in a steady-state regime of a set of 6 crimped connections at a test current of a value at most equal to the rated current. There are standards that allow the estimation of heating elements in the circuit at small variations of the test current around the real used value. In this sense, formulas were determined with which these estimates can be made. For a more precise evaluation, the variation with temperature of the electrical resistance of the 6 connectors was also taken into account, determining a global temperature coefficient of resistance, specific to the studied circuit. The formulas have been validated for several types of crimped connections used in the construction of electrical machines. The results validate the proposed formulas and even extend their validity range for larger variations of the test current around the real used value.

articleTitle: Influence of the Single-Phase Fault Passing Resistance on the Shunt Breaker Technical Efficiency
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: In the paper, the authors present the influence of the passing resistance at the location of the single-phase fault on the technical efficiency of the shunt breaker, a situation in which, even if the fault is very close to the power transformer station but has a certain fault resistance, lower or higher, the shunt fulfills its functional role of extinguishing the electric arc at the site of the single-phase fault. Also, the results of a “live” earthing test are briefly presented, which confirms the fact that the shunt breaker is not effective at faults very close to the medium voltage bus that is in operation, for an earthing by firmly tying the of a phase at the earth socket of the first pole next to the power transformer station, but in actual / usual operating conditions, when the conductor falls freely on the ground at the same pole, the connected shunt breaker leads to a current through the fault site much smaller than 10 A, and if the defect is transient, it extinguishes itself. At the end, the conclusions highlight the advantages and disadvantages of using the shunt breaker associated with treating the neutral of the medium voltage network through a resistor (R), and the influence of the transition resistance at the single-phase fault site on the technical efficiency of the shunt.

articleTitle: Implementation of Rotor Flux-Oriented Control on Traction System of Autonomous Electric Locomotives
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: The objective of this paper is to present the problem of implementing the rotor flux-oriented control through hysteresis current controllers (RFOC _H) on electric traction systems for autonomous locomotives, and it is based on the research of the authors within a POC project carried out in the years 2017–2021. Foundation of the RFOC using hysteresis current controllers and its implementation on an industrial experimental stand is accompanied by experimental results that confirm the correctness and validity of the adopted solution.

articleTitle: Design and Monitoring of a Domestic Solar Power Plant
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: The paper is part of the context of the rapid increase in power installed in photovoltaic power plants and refers to the design and monitoring of a photovoltaic domestic power plant mounted on a separate support. The photovoltaic plant was built near the city of Targu Jiu, a location that falls within the yellow zone of solar radiation. Based on the imposed power, the solar panels in monocrystalline silicon technology and the inverter are chosen. Next, it is established the number of solar panels and how to connect them, so as to achieve both the required power and the voltage required at the input of the inverters. The energy produced is also estimated, monthly and for one year, by using the dedicated application recommended by the panels manufacturer. Next, the operation monitoring system and the performance of the plant during the first eight months of operation are presented. Finally, some conclusions are summarized and is highlight the positive impact on the environment, by reducing the amount of CO2 released into the atmosphere.

articleTitle: Improvement Performances of Sensorless Control for PMSM Based on FOC Strategy Using Luenberger Observer, Sine Cosine Algorithm, and RL-TD3 Agent
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: Considering the need to increase the reliability of Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor (PMSM) control systems by eliminating speed sensors and using observers to estimate PMSM rotor speed, this paper shows a sensorless control structure-type based on the Field Oriented Control (FOC) type strategy and a Luenberger observer. In order to achieve a better performance of the observer in terms of reducing the error given by the difference between the measured value of the PMSM rotor speed and the Luenberger observer output, a Sine Cosine Algorithm (SCA) is used to optimize the tuning parameters of the Luenberger observer. Also, in order to increase the Luenberger observer performance, a Reinforcement Learning (RL), namely Twin-Delayed Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (TD3) agent is used, which after the training process supply a signal that is added to the Luenberger observer output, thus obtaining superior features of the estimation for PMSM speed. These methods to improve Luenberger observer performance are validated by numerical simulations realized in Matlab/Simulink.

articleTitle: Train Motion Study Using Matlab/App Designer
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: In order to study the train motion, the paper presents the mathematical model, the structural diagram and the SIMULINK model of the train motion. The SIMULINK model is used to generate GUI for train motion using Matlab App Designer.

articleTitle: Optimizing Energy Production for Wind Turbines Operating in Variable Wind Speed Conditions
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: Many wind power plants, especially those consisting of wind turbines with a horizontal axis and high installed power - in order of a few MW per WT - operate in locations with wind conditions that significantly vary in character over time. This entails their operation outside the maximum power point, i.e., a lower electricity production than the turbine could produce. The authors propose an optimized operation which, is based on determining the dependence of the maximum power, and implicitly the optimal mechanical angular speed, on wind speed. Starting from knowledge of the time variation of the angular mechanical speed for the no-loaded operation condition, and based on the equation of motion, we can determine the maximum power of the wind turbine. The implemented strategy based on which we computed the coordinates of the maximum power point was confronted with experimental values measured in an existing onshore wind farm, operating on the Romanian black seacoast. Based on the obtained results, the authors can identify the optimal area, from an energetic point of view, for a wind turbine operating in complex wind speed conditions.

articleTitle: Application of the Direct Power Control in a Three-Phase Shunt Active Power Filter System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: This article introduces a novel control approach called “Direct Power Control” designed for shunt active power filters. The method aims to mitigate harmonics in the supply current and counteract reactive power issues. The primary objective is to restore the active power and the reactive power to the reference values through hysteresis control. The hysteresis controllers outputs, coupled with a switching table, regulate the real-time active and reactive powers by determining the optimal switching configuration of the inverter. The paper includes the theoretical analysis as well as comprehensive system simulations and experimental findings to validate the effectiveness of the proposed technique.

articleTitle: An Analysis of the Power Factor Compensation Within the Power Grid of an Industrial Plant by Means of Supervised Learning Methods
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: This paper concerns the analysis of the efficiency of the implementation of local power factor compensators at the terminals of the main electrical execution elements - mainly large electric motors and groups of electric motors - within the electrical power network of an industrial plant. The problem is the evaluation of the power factor compensation at the level of the entire power network by means of observations at the input feeder. The pitfalls of the proposed problem are that the power factor variations - observed at the input feeder station's dashboard - are low compared to its stationary components. This makes the power factor observations inconsistent for in-depth evaluation. In this paper we propose to transform the above mentioned problem into a classification problem and implement Supervised Learning Methods for classification and predictions. In the paper, we implemented the support vector classifiers with various kernels onto the data acquired (at the fuel station dashboard) while the power factor compensator were set either on or off. The results pointed out good accuracy for the classifications (at least 70% for the training set and almost 49% for the test set). In addition, the classifiers were also successful in detecting the compensation's state of the power grid. These results recommend the proposed method for both online monitoring and fault detection of power factor compensation units.

articleTitle: Estimation of the Rotor Flux in the Traction Systems with Induction Motors and Field-Oriented Control
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: This paper is focused on the estimation of the induction motor rotor flux in a rotor flux-oriented control system applied in the electric traction of locomotives. The rotor flux-oriented control of the induction motor is one of the most commonly used methods for torque and speed control, allowing to achieve indicators of high quality in both steady-state and dynamic regimes. Two possibilities of estimating the rotor flux magnitude and angular position are analyzed. The first considers the use of the measured speed and the stator current, and the second the use of the supply voltage and the stator current. As an alternative to measuring the highly distorted voltage at the inverter output, the possibility of using the control signals of the IGBTs is analyzed. The MATLAB/Simulink software is used as a simulation environment to analyze the obtained results for the associated algorithms.

articleTitle: Research and Design Microgrid using Ocean Wave Energy for Electric Vehicles Load on Islands in Vietnam
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: The demand for Energy for development is increasing while fossil energy sources are gradually exhausted, causing many negative environmental impacts. The research and use of new and renewable energy sources is an inevitable trend, including wave energy. Therefore, the study of wave energy conversion has many meanings to develop power stations for coastal areas and islands, providing electricity for signal buoys, anchored ships, and tourist islands. Besides, electrification in transportation ushered in the explosion of electric vehicles in the world. This number of Electric Vehicles (EVs) significantly impacts the power supply to the grid. This paper builds a Microgrid model with integrated electric vehicles based on wind and wave energy sources. Several renewable energy forecasting and management algorithms help evaluate the feasibility of practical deployment for this energy source. Simulating the rules and characteristics of wave levels in Unity 3D software interact with the Microgrid (MG) model in MATLAB.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Evolution of Electricity Production in Romania
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: In the context of climate change and the global energy crisis, the demand for electricity from renewable energy sources has been set as a priority. Compared to 2010, installed capacity in power plants in Romania has decreased due to the closure or conservation of some thermal power plants. This decrease was not significant, as many renewable energy plants were commissioned. More than half of the electricity needs of renewable energy plants were covered. In the context of encouraging investment in clean energy sources, the share of renewable energy sources in electricity generation is expected to increase. In order to avoid imbalances in the national energy system, it is necessary to take measures in terms of investments in transmission and distribution lines and to encourage energy production as much as possible at the point of consumption. The paper presents an analysis of electricity production and consumption between 2010 and May 2023. It also analyses the energy mix of electricity generation sources (renewable and conventional), and at the end it makes an estimate of electricity consumption for 2024. The analysis shows a significant increase in the share of renew ables in total electricity generation in Romania.

articleTitle: Assessing Frequency Variability Using Long Term High Reporting Rate Measurements
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: Renewable's integration in power systems contributes to decreasing the available mechanical inertia., which further impacts the frequency variability in steady-state conditions of operation. In this paper two metrics are chosen to be applied to the frequency signal available with high reporting rates (up to 50 frame/s)., exhibiting random variations. The metrics are the coefficient of variation of root mean squared error CV(RMSE) and the coefficient of determination <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$R^{2}$</tex> and are applied on different measurement (200ms., 1s) over different (10s) time windows. The higher selectivity of CV(RMSE) compared to <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$R^{2}$</tex> is demonstrated for synthetic signals emulating steady-state and dynamic operation and on a set of 10 minutes recorded frequency variation in four nodes of the Romanian Power System during a severe event recorded in 2017. Also, a procedure to discriminate power system events using a flag applied to a new signal (deviation of frequency from a model adopted on each measurement window) is proposed.

articleTitle: Influence of the Wind Speed Amplitude on the Energy Captured by a Wind Turbine Operating at Time-Varying Wind Speeds
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: This paper analyzes the influence of the changing amplitude of wind speed on the energy captured from the wind by a wind turbine. The variations, over time, of the captured wind energy values at several values for the mechanical angular velocity and the wind speed amplitude are analyzed for a case study related to a wind park located on the Romanian Black Sea coast, Dobrogea. The obtained results demonstrate the significant differences that occur between the expected transformation related to the theoretical power characteristics of the wind turbine and the operation in real-time conditions under significant wind speed variations.

Author Keywords: wind energy captured by a wind turbine

articleTitle: Improving the Ecological Performance of Free-Piston Gas Generator by Air-Gas Mixture Self-Ignition
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: The paper considers the implementation of combustion of premixed mixture with compression ignition (HCCI-process) in a free-piston gas generator designed according to a scheme with oppositely moving pistons, with two compressor and buffer chambers. The processes of gas exchange and combustion of an air-gas mixture are considered in a three-dimensional formulation, considering the dynamics of pistons freely moving under the action of inertia, friction and gas forces. The mathematical model is based on the system of equations of energy, motion (Navier-Stokes), diffusion and continuity, and supplemented with ignition and combustion models (Extended Coherent Flame Model, ECFM) and heat transfer in near-wall regions. In the first cycles, the operation of free-piston gas generator with ignition of the mixture using spark plugs is considered; later, the possibility of implementing a cycle with spark-assisted compression ignition or compression ignition without the use of spark plugs is analyzed.

articleTitle: Solar Tracking Systems for Photovoltaic Panel Made for Educational Purposes
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: Increasing the efficiency of photovoltaic panels using solar tracking systems is a current topic. The paper presents two types of solar tracking systems, one based on astronomical data, and the other based on tracking the point of maximum illumination. Both systems are made for educational purposes for the analysis of methods, principles and particularities in order to use them in practical applications.

articleTitle: Design Control System of Three Phase Bidirectional DC-DC Converter for Autonomous Gas Turbine Power Plant
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: Bidirectional multichannel DC voltage converters are widely used in industry, traction electric drive and autonomous power plants. However, most studies on the control of this topology are devoted to low-power solutions with intermittent current mode. This article proposes a nested loop control system, taken by the idea of theory of an electric drive and implemented for a bidirectional three-channel DC voltage converter of an autonomous gas turbine power plant. The article considers the synthesis of the proposed system and verification of the correctness of the settings - in the SimInTech mathematical modeling environment.

articleTitle: Data-Driven Control of the Second Order Inertial Systems with Astatism
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: In order to realize an efficient synthesis of the control algorithm, it is necessary to be known the mathematical model of the control object. This paper deals with the problem of data-driven control of second order inertial systems with astatism, that supposes an experimental identification of the mathematical model in the closed-loop and algorithm for synthesis the PD and PID controllers. The control algorithm was synthesized according to the maximum stability degree method with iterations. The closed-loop identification method and synthesis algorithms of the PD and PID controllers were verified by computer simulation in MATLAB and there are obtained good results in model estimation and the tuning of the PD and PID controllers.

Author Keywords: second order inertial systems with astatism

articleTitle: Realisation of a Low-Cost Three-Axis CNC for Processing Soft Materials
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: The large-scale use of CNC machine tools has become a necessity both in the industrial environment and in workshops and smaller businesses. The precision in processing, the productivity and the diversity of the work tasks offered by the numerical control are the main arguments. But the cost of professional equipment is high and for small workshops, where the desired performance from the machine is not extremely high, in-house building of a CNC represents a solution, especially when the personnel have knowledge in electrical engineering. The work presents the conception and realization of a CNC machine tool with numerical control for the processing of soft materials. The process has two stages, first a prototype was built and, then, the construction and design errors were removed to increase the machine tool performance.

articleTitle: Assessment Of The Economic Efficiency Of Reactive Power Compensation Measures In Electrical Distribution Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: In the past the electrical load of residential consumers had a predominantly active character, thus neglecting the problems related to the compensation of reactive power in the distribution networks, however, at the present time, with the widespread spread of new types of electrical equipment (microwave ovens, air conditioning, fluorescent lamps, washing machines, personal computers, etc.), which consume an important reactive power from the network, the problem of reactive power compensation and increasing the power factor in electrical networks has become a priority. It is known that a low power factor has a number of negative consequences on the electrical network work, such as increasing active power losses, reducing of energy installations capacity, additional investments, etc. Power factor improvement can be achieved via various organizational measures or through producing reactive power on site using specialized sources of reactive power (capacitor batteries, synchronous compensators). In the paper it was considered the installation of capacitor batteries in 0.4-10 kV distribution electrical networks for reactive power compensation, the results of the calculations indicating a reduction of active power losses in power lines by 1.18-1.32 times, and in step-down transformers by 1.25 - 1.15 times. Investment costs for the installation of capacitor batteries are reimbursed up to 5 years only from the reduction of active power losses in the network.

articleTitle: Study Regarding the Level of a Hydrogenerator Partial Discharges
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: In order to ensure electricity requirements, it is necessary that there are no interruptions in the operation of power plants, caused by various defects. For this purpose, a permanent monitoring of the sizes and operating parameters of the aggregates is necessary. Determining the condition of the insulation is an important characteristic in the proper operation of electrical generators. In order to determine the insulation condition of the stator winding of a hydrogenerator, measurements were accomplished in order to determine the level of partial discharges when the generator is operating at idle state and loaded. From the analysis of the variation of the level of partial discharges as a function of voltage and power, it appears that the windings of the tested generator are so far adequate in terms of insulation. However, attention should be paid to the winding on phase A, where no linear variations were found. At the same time, the windings temperature and the operating regime influence the value of the partial discharges. In order to prevent the failure of the generators determined by the degradation of the windings insulation over time, it is necessary to carry out periodically specific measurements.

articleTitle: Application of SCADA System in an Electrical Substation and Remote Terminal Unit Parametrization
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: In order to efficiently and practically solve the problem of SCADA (Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition) system performance analysis of the power grid, this paper proposes to change a solution with PLC and software for protocol conversion installed on the local HMI to a remote terminal unit (A8000) specialized for data storage and protocol conversion in power substations. The paper discusses the main Programmable Logic Controller (PLC) tasks, their classificationfrom a structural point of view and their operation mode. Also, the structure of an RTU including CPU, process interface, communication interface, user interface and their role in the electrical substation is presented. In the last part of the paper, the parameterization of the RTU A8000 in an electrical substation in Romania is presented and highlighted with screenshots.

articleTitle: Improved Distance Measurement Using Ultrasonic Sensors
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: The paper presents a system based on an ultrasonic emitter and two ultrasonic receivers which can locate more precise an object located in their detection range, being able to measure the distance to the object and the angle in respect with the front perpendicular direction. The sensors are read by a Lab View virtual instrument that drives the emitter and collect the echoes and based on geometrical equation computes the two parameters. The system architecture, the software application and some preliminary results will be presented in the paper.

articleTitle: A Study of a Fractional Slot Concentrated Wound Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor with Grain Oriented Electric Steel Lamination for Modular Stator Geometry
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: Nowadays the industry of electrical machines is looking for different procedures to reduce the effective cost of materials used in the manufacturing process, but at the same time to reach a good balance of efficiency. There might be many ways to obtain such a performance. It is obvious, that these machines should experience multiple adjustments to fulfill the desired requirements. The current study proposes an approach to reducing the iron core losses of Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor (PMSM) with Fractional Slot Concentrated Wound (FSCW) by using a modular Grain-Oriented (GO) stator with steel lamination sheets. A modular structure means the yoke and teeth are distributed in multiple geometry assemblies that form together the motor stationary armature. It is known the fact that alternating current motors with an increased number of magnetic poles require a higher frequency to reach a high angular speed. At these high frequencies, the iron core loss is most significant. This study intends to provide several Finite Element Analyses (FEA) to draw different characteristics of the presented motor geometry. Finally, iron core losses are calculated, and the power balance is realized.

Author Keywords: fractional-slot concentrated-wound permanent magnet synchronous motor

articleTitle: Automation of Dust Removal Process and Application in Industrial Environment
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: In the light of the increasing concern for the environment and its protection, this paper presents a subject that is in line with these concerns and that deals with the field of industrial activities where materials are produced by breaking, grinding, cutting, crushing or where powdery bulk materials are used that are transported by conveyor belts and where their discharge and transfer from one belt to another cause the release of dust and harmful pollutants that contaminate the environment. This includes cement plants, civil and industrial construction component manufacturing plants, mining plants, i.e. areas where materials such as cement, sand, coal, lime, gypsum, etc. are handled. This article presents the principles, structure, block diagram and development of an automatic system for dust removal in industrial environments.

articleTitle: Energy Crises – Energy Transition Driving Force
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: The geographical distribution of energy resources on the territory of a limited number of countries allows them to hold a monopoly and dictate the regulations in the fuel markets, subsequently often causing energy crises. These, as a result, are leading to economic crises, food crises, and social crises. Anti-crisis measures taken by society have a positive impact on energy development. Thus, the oil crisis of the 1970s turned energy efficiency into a self-contained problem, independent of the technical fields to which it is applied. The recent gas crisis has led to a high increase in the installed capacities of renewable energy sources and may be a turning point in the energy transition toward a cleaner and more secure global energy system.

articleTitle: System-Level Modelling, Analysis, and Validation of a Soccer Robot's Shooting Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: This paper presents a modelling framework for the shooting system of the Tech United soccer robot involved in RoboCup. This framework accounts for the magnetic design of the plunger, commutation of the power electronics, including the passive components, as well as the mechanical part which includes the lobbing system. The simulation results give insight into the system performance and quantitatively indicate further possible improvements.

articleTitle: Design and Manufacturing Aspects of a Lightweight Racing Electric Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: With the rapid development of the electric vehicle industry, academic and industrial studies have also gained importance. In particular, efforts have been made to develop electric and hybrid electric vehicles and to make them more efficient. The production of traditional fossil fuel vehicles in the automotive industry has slowed down with the pandemic. Since fossil fuels are also disadvantageous in terms of carbon emissions and have negative effects on global warming, studies to reduce carbon emissions have gained value. In this context, various countries have played an important role in the development of electric vehicle technology by organizing various initiatives and organizations in both academic and industrial fields. In this study, various experiences about the electrical and mechanical design and production of a prototype electric vehicle designed for intercollegiate races organized to develop the electric vehicle industry are shared.

articleTitle: Stabilization of Inverter Losses in a Traction Drive of Electric Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: Thermal deviations bring the main impact on the lifetime of the traction drive inverters. Some of them caused by low-frequency currents at low speeds, but the heaviest thermal cycles occur because of the deviations of the traction force command. Using open-end winding motor this paper will present an active thermal control strategy, which varies modulation frequency in order to stabilize losses in the traction inverter and temperature of the power semiconductors helping to increase their lifetime. The proposed method of the loss stabilization helps to reduce temperature swings. The simulation results show that the active thermal control stabilizes the power losses in the traction inverter regardless of the mission profile.

articleTitle: Solar Tracking Systems for Photovoltaic Panel Made for Educational Purposes
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: Increasing the efficiency of photovoltaic panels using solar tracking systems is a current topic. The paper presents two types of solar tracking systems, one based on astronomical data, and the other based on tracking the point of maximum illumination. Both systems are made for educational purposes for the analysis of methods, principles and particularities in order to use them in practical applications.

articleTitle: Experimental Investigations of the Operation of LC Filters Driven by SSRs
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: Currently, almost all electrical consumers have non-linear volt-ampere characteristic, which leads to the absorption of non-sinusoidal currents from the electrical network. The deforming regime of non-linear consumers can cause several problems in electrical installations. To decrease the deforming regime, passive LC absorbing filters connected in parallel with the consumers can be used. Theoretically, these filters are tuned to a certain frequency (in practice interharmonic). The article presents an analysis of the use of LC passive filters connected in the circuit by solid-state relays. The analysis is done by using different LC filters (with various capacitors and inductors), connected through electrical contacts, type-Z and type-R solid-state relays. It has been determined experimentally that LC filters can be connected through Z-type solid-state relays, so that they are connected at the zero crossing of the voltage and disconnected at the zero crossing of the current. In this way, the classic electrical contacts can be replaced when connecting/ disconnecting the LC filters.

articleTitle: Using the Variable Flow Hydropower Potential of a Drinking Water Supply Pipe of a Small Town
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: The use of the hydro-energetic potential of the adduction pipelines for the water supply of the localities is a desideratum that is only at the beginning of the road, although in Romania there is the possibility of obtaining an installed power of over 300 MW. In the present paper, an application with a power of 100 KW, made in a small town, is presented. The main component elements of the micro hydropower plant and its principle operation in fully automated mode, without the presence of human personnel, are described. With the help of a dedicated software, a preliminary analysis of the feasibility of this project is made.

articleTitle: System for Monitoring Electrical Cables Condition in Building Installation
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: The monitoring and diagnosis of electric cables it was a constant concern in installations of medium and high voltage networks, but nowadays it becomes important also for buildings. Electrical installations in an office building, hospitals or commercial enterprises must operate without technical deviations on a normal operating day. Different techniques can be used for monitoring and diagnosis, but the chosen solution must comply with the specificity of building and cables in use, and also with the budget available for monitoring and maintenance. The paper presents a system conceived for monitoring the operational and environmental factors that could lead to cables aging and for providing real-time alerts when a possible fault can occur. The results of testing the system on a simulated cable installation are presented.

articleTitle: Experiments on the Measurement of the Electromagnetic Field
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: This work presents aspects related to the protection that must be provided to workers against safety and health risks when they are exposed to electromagnetic fields. A series of experimental determinations carried out in the electromagnetic compatibility (EMC) laboratory are presented. The purpose of the tests is to determine the level of the electromagnetic field registered in the room under conditions where measurements are not carried out. We considered the dedicated testing equipment was turned off during the experiments. We measured the level of the electromagnetic field to check if it exceeds the maximum limit imposed by Directive 2013/35/EU. This directive regulates the maximum limits allowed at the level of the European Union. These limits are applicable to all member and partner countries.

articleTitle: Numerical Modelling of Two-Dimensional Conduction for Different Wall Structures
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: The paper presents the numerical modeling study of two-dimensional conduction for different wall structures. In the first part of the paper in introduction is presented the importance of the numerical modelling including a presentation of the most important existing numerical models for two dimensional conduction. The paper continues with the presentation of the main equations used for numerical modelling of two-dimensional heat conduction. The case study includes five numerical examples of such modelling: numerical modelling of a homogeneous plane parallel wall, numerical modelling of a homogeneous, plane parallel, infinite wall, numerical modelling of a plane parallel wall stressed differently on the two faces, numerical modelling of a homogeneous, plane parallel, infinite wall clad with an insulated layer on one face and numerical modelling of a wall composed of two layers of different materials.

articleTitle: Comparison and Rule-Based Implementation in IMA-NET of PHP Compression Functions
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: Often, choosing the right file compression method to use, especially when we are developing a web application, can be a difficult task as we have to consider server storage limits and application performance. To facilitate developers' work, a study regarding which compression algorithm suits specific file types was performed. This study deals with a comprehensive comparison of PHP functions designed for data compression through a series of experiments and case studies, the functions' effectiveness across different types of data, varying compression ratios, and computational requirements are assessed. Afterward, the results gathered are implemented into a new feature developed for a real-life application called IMA-NET. The Innovative e-Management Platform for Academic Network (IMA-NET), created three years ago, has as its main goal to digitally manage different courses and events organized by the Central European Exchange Program for University Studies (CEEPUS) network. The application allows for collecting valuable information like students' preferred topics, feedback regarding the organized event, or generating certificate templates for the participants. After different successful probations of this application, built on top of PHP, we implemented the results of this paper into the new feature added to increase the inter activity among teachers and students inside the application by giving them the possibility to share materials among each other. Notably, the article investigates the interplay between the choice of compression function and the nature of data being compressed, guiding the selection of the optimal function for specific use cases. The results obtained empower developers to make informed and rules-based assisted choices when implementing data compression solutions in PHP-based applications, ultimately leading to more efficient, responsive, and user-friendly web experiences.

articleTitle: In-wheel Slotless Permanent Magnet Electrical Machines for Solar Vehicle Propulsion
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: This paper presents the optimization for two versions of in-wheel permanent magnet synchronous machines, with toroidal winding, for the propulsion of a light electric solar vehicle. Design evaluation based on 2D finite-element field analysis proves that the slotless permanent magnet machines could be of interest for this application, if the efficiency requirements are not too high, or if the nominal operation power is low.

articleTitle: Comparative Study Regarding Radiative Cooling Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: Radiative heating and cooling systems have seen a considerable increase in use lately, not only in residential but also in commercial buildings, due to their high comfort level, their lower noise level and the higher ability to integrate them within the building architecture, when compared to others. These systems can use renewable energy sources, ensuring that the heating is achieved with low-temperature hot water and the cooling with high-temperature cold water. This paper is meant to conduct a comparative study of the energy consumption for a radiative cooling system of a space, for a floor, ceiling or wall system, by using the COOLPACK specialized program. At the same time, this paper is addressed to students, with a view to analyzing the phenomenon of heat transfer through radiation.

Author Keywords: the use of the COOLPACK program

articleTitle: 3D Printed Upper Limb Prosthesis Controlled by the Healthy Hand
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: This paper deals with designing, 3D printing and testing of an upper limb prosthesis that supports two very important types of hand motion, which are fist rotation and grabbing/releasing an object. The prosthesis is able to mirror the movement of a human arm with the help of a ring that contains a gyroscopic sensor, placed on the healthy hand. The ring, which translates the angular movement into electrical signals processed by the microcontroller, controls the servomotors which finally drive the components of the prosthesis, fingers and wrist rotation system. In that way both, prosthesis and healthy hand, can interact to pick-up an object, to orient it and to place it in a preffered place. This master project has been accomplished as a proof-of-concept that there is a possibility to help less fortunate people, that suffered upper limb amputation, with a more accessible prosthesis.

articleTitle: Conceptual Design for the Performance of Public Infrastructure and Utilities in Urban Water Treatment Plants
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: This paper contains the description of the solutions and tools for the implementation of this project. The proposed solutions are based on the implementation of new technologies in the technological part of water treatment and in the electromechanical part. New equipment and methods are selected based on the quantitative and qualitative analysis of the work front. Based on this design, a new water pumping and treatment network will be built for a city in the Republic of Moldova.

articleTitle: Influence of Nonlinearity and Driving Angles on the Functional and Performance Characteristics at SRMs
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: This paper presents a comparative analysis of the functional characteristics of a Switched Reluctance Motor (SRM) 6/4, for two different variants: a) idealized - with linear variation of inductance; real - with nonlinear variation of inductance. The analysis is performed in the PSIM environment, using the same control strategy, respectively conventional pulse current driving method, but for different values of the driving angle (at linear variant). Additionally, the performance of the SRM is analyzed in terms of energy efficiency by visualizing losses and temperature distribution within the structure, using the Motor-CAD software.

articleTitle: Device for Monitoring the Condition of People with Balance Problems
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: People with balance problems require attention related to their monitoring and care. Various medical or aging conditions can cause these conditions and can have quite an impact on the daily life of these people, therefore, in order to provide them with proper assistance and care, various health monitoring devices have been developed. This device aims to use advanced technologies with which we can easily detect and record changes in the balance state of a person with such problems. The device contains sensors that can measure parameters such as body position, such as body position by measuring the height from the ground. The device can be worn as a belt or bracelet to record the date in real time. This data is analyzed and interpreted by the device's software, which can detect sudden or abnormal changes in posture, providing notifications and alerts when the person has suffered a fall. With this monitoring, the device also provides an objective assessment of a person's balance ability. The device developed must be tested a period of time to adjust software coefficients, to avoid triggering false events.

articleTitle: Research Using Modular Resistive Power Load Blocks for Frequent Starting of Wound Rotor Induction Motor, Used in High Power Testing Laboratories
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: Based on the fact that rheostatic starting, the most common starting method, is specific to wound rotor induction motor, but has a number of distinct disadvantages, this article presents a new modular resistive power load blocks design, used in rheostatic starters of wound rotor induction motor. Soft starters (static converters) or rheostatic starters are used to start wound rotor induction motors. The special design consists in the fact that the resistor elements are arranged by welding in such a way as to eliminate the inductive phenomenon and to eliminate the multiple connections with screws. Another new feature is the use of austenitic stainless steel as the resistor material, which is suitable for the frequent start-ups typical of High Power Test Laboratories.

articleTitle: Intensity of the Waves from the Black Sea an Energetic Advantage but also a Risk of Coastal Erosion
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: Due to international conditions, any renewable energy source must be exploited. The Romanian coast is subjected 6–8 months/year to high wind speeds that produce waves of 2–5 m in height. In three points along the coastline, for five years, measurements of waves were carried out. It was estimated their energetic potential. Waves' characteristics, frequency of occurrence, and the produced energy are presented. A calculation algorithm is presented to determine the energy of the cumulative unit both on height intervals and as a period. On the other hand, the intensity of the waves led to coastal erosion in the southern area. The movement of solid particles under the action of waves and the priority direction of erosion induced by the shape of the Romanian coast are mentioned. The trajectory and the regressive direction of movement are obtained under the action of the incident waves. The study underlines the energy potential of waves in areas without tourism as a supplementary source near wind farms.

articleTitle: Using AR in Technical Education. The ARphymedes case
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: To attract students to the study of technical sciences, Augmented reality (AR) brings high hopes. But the use of AR in education has not yet reached a level of maturity. The paper first makes a short review with the main results in the field reported in the literature. Then, it analyzes the ARphymedes project, emphasizing the goal, the achievements but also the difficulties encountered, with the goal to understand better this kind of educational approach.

articleTitle: Synthesis of Agent-Based Decision-Making Systems with Multiple Coalitions
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: This paper presents a synthesis method of decision-making systems based on Agents forming multiple coalitions. The condition for coalition formation is defined by a mathematical model that solves the problem of global optimization of the objective function. The problem of synthesizing the agent-based system was formulated, and the mathematical model for negotiating the coalition formation process was developed. The process of initiation, dialogue and coalition formation is presented based on the sequence diagram. For structural modeling, Membrane Computation (P-Systems) models are used that highlight the parallelism and topology of the Multi-Agent system. The Agent structure is defined as a collection of knowledge (data and processing methods) and input/output ports. The functional validation of the Agent and the Multi-Agent system was performed based on the Timed Petri Nets.

articleTitle: FPGA Power Consumption Optimization Methods Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: This paper aims to provide an analysis and study of power consumption methods in FPGAs. Power consumption is important when designing energy-efficient, reliable, and cost-effective digital systems. As FPGAs are being used in applications in a wide range of industries, understanding and implementing power-efficient design strategies become increasingly important. For this purpose, we have used different VHDL designs, and the power optimization methods are implemented in Vivado. The VHDL designs tested, combinational and sequential, are different in components and complexity to analyze the impact of power optimization tools. This paper shows that for different implementations it is necessary to choose the appropriate power-optimizing method.

articleTitle: Development of the Six-Phase Static Converter with Symmetrical and Asymmetrical Control for Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: The paper presents the development of a six-phase converter coupled with a six-phase asynchronous motor with two symmetrical three-phase windings. The main purpose of this paper is to test the designed and developed symmetrical six-phase asynchronous motor controlled by the six-phase converter. Using the developed converter to measure the electromechanical characteristics of the prototype motor and the frequency characteristics. According to results is observed that the second star has low currents compared to the first star and as a result the power generated by it is less. This may be caused by the construction of the motor winding as it has been rewound.

articleTitle: Steady State Condition of Cable Line 10 kV at Single-Phase to Ground Fault with Resistive Neutral Earthing
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: The work is devoted to the study of the steady state mode of cable line 10 kV at single-phase short circuit and resistive grounding of the neutral. A model of a cable line, implemented in the MATLAB-SIMULINK package was used. Also the models of supply transformer and additional transformer for creation of artificial neutral point were used, based on available standard elements. So, the specifics of operation of additional transformer for creation an artificial neutral point and real parameters of the cable and transformers were taken into account. It is shown that in the resistive grounding mode the nature of the displacement of the linear supply voltages triangle at variation of the fault resistance differs from what takes place in the partial compensation and overcompensation modes. At single-phase short circuit and any value of fault resistance, the choice of the value of the resistor in the neutral significantly affect the magnitude of the current and voltage in it. However, the current and the voltage at the place of damage at large values of the fault resistance does not significantly depend on the value of the neutral resistor.

articleTitle: Monitoring of Classical and Modern Education
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: The material base within an educational process, be it classic or distance learning, contributes to the development of factors that stimulate learning, having principles defined according to the learning method chosen by students. An important role is played by teachers who must develop this material basis of learning according to principles adapted to all learners, especially in the case of online education, when teachers and students are separated. This last case grew with the advent of the COVID-19 pandemic period. Therefore, in our study we presented the two methods, classical and modern, which combined, could make it possible to teach in high schools or universities even during the pandemic. At the end of this study, an evaluation of the two methods was made and an improvement in students' results was found, increasing their interest in learning and at the same time reducing the costs of implementing laboratory works by using a small amount of equipment.

articleTitle: Estimating the Influence of Random Factors on the Operational Reliability of Electricity Supply Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: The aim of this work is to estimate the influence of random factors on the operational reliability of electricity supply networks. In order to achieve the proposed aim, the interruptions in operation, caused by the influencing factors, which occurred randomly in the process of operation of the examined power grids were recorded and processed. Specific random factors were selected as the object of the research, because at present they occur frequently and interrupt the electricity supply process unpredictably, essentially affecting consumers and causing them significant harm. The main results of the research consist in establishing the characteristics of outages and mathematical expressions that allow to estimate the influence of random factors on the level of reliability, depending on: the number of outages caused, their duration and the number of consumers affected. Moreover, the research has made it possible to highlight factors with a significant influence on reliability, which allows planning measures to prevent them and ensure the continuity of the electricity supply process. The significance of the results obtained lies in the solution to a number of problems currently faced by the electricity supply network operating services, in order to ensure operational reliability, providing the possibility of forecasting random influencing factors, which allows the justified implementation of prophylactic works and ensuring the level of reliability.

articleTitle: Basic Aspects of the Theoretical and Practical Relevance of the Method of Synchronous Multi-Zone PWM for Power Inverters
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: This paper briefly reviews the development and widespread use of an alternative method of synchronous multi-zone pulse width modulation (SMZ PWM), based on a non-standard time-domain-oriented space vector approach, for the adjustment of voltage source inverters (VSINs) and inverter-based ac drives with relatively low switching frequency (SwFr) of VSINs. It is shown that basic peculiarities of the method assures better understanding of modulation processes in power conversion systems (it is an important and useful educational aspect of the method), and also insures continuous synchronization and symmetry of the basic voltages in systems with both integral and fractional ratios between the SwFr of inverters and fundamental frequency (FFr) of installations, allowing minimization of subharmonics in spectra of voltage of VSINs and VSIN-based apparatuses. Examples of the use of the method of SMZ PWM to regulate several topologies of inverter-based three-phase, dual three-phase, five-phase, and six-phase drive installations are presented.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Performances of Photovoltaic Power Plants
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: The aim of this paper is the comparative study of the behavior and performances of two photovoltaic power plants of different installed power. The two plants use identical equipment, the difference in size being given by the number of specific equipment used. The plant behavior was investigated, as the injected active power is dependent on the available sunlight to the photovoltaic panels (and a larger plant leads to a larger panel area), as well as the influence of the power plants to the power grid, given the fact that a large power plant will inject more active power, and the grid local power transformer must be able to accept this power. The power plants efficiency was also investigated, as typically, the bigger the plant, the higher the efficiency must be. But, the efficiency depends on the generated active power (which must be high, to have a good efficiency) and in the case of photovoltaic power plants, the produced power depends on the available sunlight, and again, the bigger the plant, the bigger the panel area susceptible to be shaded.

articleTitle: Comparative Study in Terms of the Energy Supply of a Residential House, through Different Methods
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: In the context of the major problem caused by the exhaustible nature of fuels and their harmful impact on the environment, the concepts of sustainable development and energy efficiency have been generated, meant to ration the consumption of primary resources. The current situation, with an influence on energy prices, also adds to them. This paper analyses and compares different ways of supplying a residential home, from the supply by means of a heating system running on methane fuel, power supply from the electrical energy provider to which the house is connected, and the supply by means of a heat pump, namely by hybrid supply by means of the heat pump - photovoltaic panels set.

Author Keywords: comparative analysis of the energy supply of a residential house through different methods

articleTitle: Improving Performance of Low-Cost Microcontroller Equipment, Based on Systematic Errors Correction
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: Low-cost devices may have characteristics that do not make them attractive for their inclusion in high-performance equipment. Microcontrollers are an example of devices that can be found in a wide range of applications and that also determine a suitable price. The objective of the paper is to present a method of obtaining superior performances with a microcontroller characterized by a low price. The reduction of offset or amplification errors through hardware and software methods has been analyzed, so that D/A conversion errors, for example, do not exceed its intrinsic error. The method can also be used for A/D conversions. For comparison, experimental determinations will be made without and with the necessary corrections. These can be done both individually and simultaneously, for both corrections. These corrections are made both by the source code written in the microcontroller, but also in the external conditioning circuits of the microcontroller.

articleTitle: Experimental Investigations of the Operation of Capacitors Driven by SSRs
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: Capacitors have applications in electronics, electrical engineering, and power engineering. Although they are considered simple circuit elements, if not used properly, they can create malfunctions and disturbances. The article presents an analysis of the use of capacitors connected in the circuit by solid-state relays. The analysis is done by using AC capacitors of various capacitances, connected through electrical contacts, type-Z and type-R solid-state relays. It has been determined experimentally that up to a certain capacitance, capacitors can be connected through Z-type solid-state relays, so that they are connected at the zero crossing of the voltage and disconnected at the zero crossing of the current.

articleTitle: Remote Health Monitoring System to Prevent the Spread of Contagious Viruses
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: In the context of the emergence of new types of diseases and viruses that can exploit certain deficiencies of the human immune system, different types of vaccines and treatments have been developed to combat the new threats. In order to monitor the health status of a patient suffering from a particular condition, various technical solutions have been proposed so that the effectiveness of a particular treatment scheme can be certified. It is proposed a solution, based on the Arduino development platform,for monitoring the health status. The platform has the possibility to transmit data collected from a sensorial system and store them to a remote device. The system is designed to monitor human body temperature with three temperature sensors placed on the head, body and lower limbs to obtain the average body temperature; an oximeter sensor for simultaneously monitoring the heart rate and the blood oxygen level of a patient; and two sensors for measuring indoor air quality, namely a gas sensor and a temperature and humidity sensor. This latter sensor is used to decide whether the environment is conducive to certain bacteria or viruses. The remote health monitoring system was designed using a dedicated software package, then manufactured using a 3D printer. The built system is robust and compact, being suitable for long-term use.

articleTitle: Sensory System Based on Intelligent Sensors for Implementation of a Modern Weather Station
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: When we discuss the quick development of technology, the weather station has become an asset for those who want to enjoy a tool that can provide accurate data about temperature, pressure, and various weather data, but also an essential element in the successful operation and development of various economic branches. In this work, we have presented how to take information from the environment and use it to create predictions. Using a modular concept, we can easily connect several controllers without making significant changes to the original system, which is a great advantage over other products on the market.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Controller Tuning Methods for First-Order Inertia Object Model with Astatism and Non-Minimum Phase
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: This paper presents a comparative analysis of controller tuning procedures for first-order inertia object models with astatism and non-minimum phase, using methods such as the maximum stability degree with iterations and polynomial method. The procedure for tuning the controller for first-order inertia object model with astatism and non-minimum phase is developed using the maximum stability degree method with iterations. Analytical expressions for controller tuning parameters as nonlinear functions of the stability degree and known object parameters are derived. The stability degree is varied, and these functions are graphically constructed. Sets of controller parameter values are selected on these curves for the same argument value through iteration procedures, and simulation is used to determine the highest performance and robustness of the system. A controller synthesis procedure is developed using the modified polynomial method. To verify and compare the results, an example is studied using the proposed methods, as well as by applying pole-zero, Ziegler-Nichols, and parametric optimization methods. System simulations with performance analysis are conducted by varying object model parameters from nominal values by ±50 %, verifying the system's robustness. The advantages of the maximum stability degree method with iterations, with reduced calculations and minimal time, are highlighted, along with the benefits of the modified polynomial method, which simplifies the controller tuning procedure for these object models.

Author Keywords: first-order inertia object model with astatism and non-minimum phase

articleTitle: Practical Aspects of Implementing Street and Park Lighting Projects
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: Smart cities have been identified as key to achieving the energy efficiency targets proposed for 2020 and 2050. The problems of economic growth, social development, progress, technology transfer, intelligent services, smart specialization - need of new workforce that will be able to use / integrate the high performance technologies. In the framework of the national project “Smart Specialization - Innovative Public Lighting solutions for Smart City” was carried out an analysis of real projects on public lighting systems implemented in the Republic of Moldova, which were determinant in the implementation of public street lighting pilot projects in the campus and in the Dendrological Park of Technical University of Moldova in the frame of the national.

articleTitle: Comparative Study of Compression Functions in Modern Web Programming Languages
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: With the increasing volume of data being generated and transferred every day, storage space has become a valuable resource. The huge size of these files, such as multimedia or software ones, have also a negative impact when it comes to the bandwidth usage they require while sharing them. On the other hand, it becomes even harder for this data to coexist in different operating systems and to offer the needed security since we face different types and formats of them. The file compression process comes as a solution to all of the above problems. It helps to optimize storage space, improve transfer speeds, enhance security, reduce bandwidth usage, and ensure compatibility across different platforms. Recently, the explosion of data generated by the Internet of Things (IoT), social media, and other sources has put even greater pressure on file compression technologies since they needed to apply to programming languages that run on web servers. As more and more data are generated, the need for efficient, effective compression algorithms becomes increasingly important. Studying the way these algorithms behave in a specific web programming language is also important. Based on historical usage and current trends in the web development industry regarding programming languages, Python, JavaScript, and PHP continue to be widely used and popular among developers. Some key factors contributing to their popularity include their ease of learning, extensive community support, versatility, web-focused features, integration capabilities, availability of frameworks, and improvements in performance and scalability. In this article, we will explore different optimization methods used for image and file compression and how they are integrated into modern web programming languages.

articleTitle: Electric Vehicle Architecture Modeling Based on MATLAB and SysML for Discrete and Continuous Simulation
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: European Parliament program Fit for 55 of request without CO2 emissions for vehicles and vans in 2035. This objective can be achieved by passing to electric or hydrogen-fueled vehicles. In this paper we are describing the necessity of architecture modeling corresponding to ASPICE and ISO 26262 standards. The aim of this paper is to describe how we can model the architecture of an electric vehicle using MATLAB Simulink and SysML universal graphical modeling language. This paper will also explain how we can integrate MATLAB Simulink model in a SysML tool for a better discrete and continuous simulation. A complete description of how the system is modeled and simulated in MATLAB Simulink and in the Rhapsody SysML tool, based on what type of diagrams are used for each tool is presented in this paper.

articleTitle: Control, Command and Regulation System Based on Virtual Instrumentation for Three-Phase Alternating High Current Source
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: The paper presents a fully digital control system based on virtual instrumentation that replaces the physical control, command and regulation panel made up of electronic modules and analogue devices. This enables the transition from primarily manual local control by the operator to remote control and eventually full automation of the heating testing process for medium and low voltage switchgear. Taking advantage of virtual instrumentation, the solution can be easily implemented and enhanced by integrating process control and computerisation applications.

articleTitle: Web-based Calculator Tool for FPGA Power Consumption Estimation for Teaching Purposes
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: Field Programmable Gate Arrays (FPGAs) are reprogrammable integrated circuits that are used to implement custom digital logic designs. FPGA power consumption is an important factor to consider when designing and using these devices. The power consumption of an FPGA is influenced by several factors, including the size and complexity of the design, the technology used to implement the design, clock frequency, features, and capabilities of the FPGA. Generally, larger and more complex designs require more power to implement. FPGAs are fabricated by using more advanced technologies, such as 28nm or 16nm, which tend to consume less power than those using older technologies, such as 90nm or 65nm. The clock frequency is another important factor that affects FPGA power consumption. The higher the clock frequency, the higher the power consumption. This is because the circuits in the FPGA have to switch more frequently, leading to increased power consumption. FPGA power consumption is a complex topic that depends on several factors. Designers must carefully consider these factors when selecting an FPGA and designing a custom logic solution to optimize power consumption for their specific application. In order to provide some automated tools to help calculate FPGA power consumption, we have designed a free web-based calculator tool for teaching purposes that provides simplified versions of the complex formulas. This tool aims to help students better understand FPGA power consumption calculation.

articleTitle: Photovoltaic Stations with NPC Inverters Adjusted by Specific Control and PWM Schemes and Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: This paper presents brief overview of the use of modulated neutral-point-clamped (NPC) inverters (NPCINs) with specific control and modulation schemes and techniques as basic workhorses of transformer-based grid-connected photovoltaic (PV) stations. Therefore, the using of NPCINs with modified schemes and algorithms of synchronous PWM insures providing in PV installations both synchronization and symmetry of the winding voltage of power transformer, and minimization of common mode voltage in these renewable energy systems. Examples of the use of modulated NPCINs to adjust several topologies of NPCIN-based PV stations with multi-winding power transformer are presented.

articleTitle: Numerical Solution of the Heat Conductance Equation
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: This paper studies different simulation models of the thermal conduction equation to determine different types of temperature distributions along a thin, solid, homogeneous bar that is insulated along its length. In the first part of the paper it is proposed to solve this partial derivative equation using a numerical approach based on the finite difference method of approximating the derivatives, and in the second part of the paper the results obtained are determined by numerical and graphical simulations.

articleTitle: Low Speed Direct Drive Electrical Generator for Multi-Blade Wind Turbine Application
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: This paper presents the design and optimization results for a direct drive high torque, low-speed spoke-type permanent magnet generator driven by a multi-blade wind turbine rotor. The generator has an outer-rotor structure and a combination of 45 slots and 34 rotor poles to reduce the cogging torque. The optimization results, using JMAG software, show that an average efficiency increase of approximatively 0.7<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup> is attained.

Author Keywords: spoke-type outer rotor permanent magnet generator

articleTitle: Infrared Monitoring of Low Voltage Switch Separator Contact Resistance
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: In the paper are presented the common aspects about the electrical contact resistance of the electrical equipment. Also, are presented the mathematical model for determining the value of contact resistance and its components. The paper presents the values obtained on a laboratory experiment, which aimed to present the temperature of each phase for a of a low voltage switch separator. The case study also highlights what are the most vulnerable points of the electrical equipment under investigation.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Regime Parameters of Longitudinal-Transverse Booster Transformers
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: The design and development of modern unified power systems based on the Smart Grid concept requires high level of electrical networks controllability that can be done using equipment controlled by power electronics. Thus, the development and study of the such devices characteristics are relevant. The research objects are transformer devices that provide voltage and power flows regulation in networks. The work purpose is to determine the energy characteristics of the devices under consideration and conduct a comparative analysis to identify their advantages and disadvantages. The goal was achieved during processing the results of computational experiments performed on the basis of structural simulation models. The paper novelty consists in the comparative analysis of the energy characteristics of the research objects, the results of which made it possible to determine a device with the best characteristics for implementation in the form of laboratory sample.

articleTitle: Verification and Validation of Safety Critical System Requirements
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: The development of systems with increased safety and security is a long and complex process that is completed by obtaining from a Notify Body the design verification certificate and the certificate of compliance with the specific regulations to the field in which the system will be used. Obtaining the verification certificate is based, among others, on the reports prepared by the verifiers and validators. The multitude of regulations and standards covering project management, life cycle development and systems engineering create some confusion in how the activities of the verification and validation processes should be carried out. Therefore, some clarifications are needed to contribute to the development of procedures or guidelines for organizations developing and manufacturing high safety systems such as those in the manufacturing of railway vehicles. This article clarifies how verification and validation of high security systems requirements should be performed.

articleTitle: Increasing the Efficiency of the Drying Process of Seeded Fruit Products with the Application of Microwave Tunnel Treatment
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: The aim of this work consists in increasing the efficiency of the drying process of seeded fruit products with the application of microwave tunnel treatment. To reach the proposed aim, an experimental electrical installation has been designed, developed, tested, optimized and implemented, applying the tunnel microwave treatment process in the drying process.
